objective: Assemble supporting evidence to formulate six arguments ready for discussion which could challenge core components of Fatima, Zeitoun and Pio.

requirements.requirement: Six explicit arguments, rather than questions or six declared victories
requirements.inspection: Six numbered sections; each gives target, argumentative conclusion, named sources, counterweight and limit.

requirements.requirement: Address core components across all three cases

evidence.target: Solar colors and rotation as discriminator of extraordinary external source
evidence.primary: Coelho, A Ordem 16/17 October 1917; DCF III-1 docs97/109
evidence.limit: Partial comparison, not full motion or event replication.

evidence.target: Predictive force as an unrelated date coincidence
evidence.primary: DCF I doc3; DCF III-1 docs33A/289
evidence.limit: Promise retained; no numerical base rate; earlier events may also have been miracles. Connected to DA-F1.

evidence.target: Several independent reported directions converge on an emitter over the Cova
evidence.primary: DCF III-1 docs79/319; Amorim1960; De Marchi; Haffert; checked geography register
evidence.limit: Does not refute remote solar experiences; target is stronger convergence inference.

evidence.target: Large crowd independently establishes detailed physical human form
evidence.primary: Watani 5May1968 p2, original Arabic twins report; ZT-061
evidence.limit: Unnamed indirect comparison; strongest prolonged form reports remain.

evidence.target: Historical controls eliminate chemical wound maintenance
evidence.limit: Does not demonstrate actual manufacture or full longitudinal fit. Continues open P-02.

evidence.target: Intermittent/selective sincere fragrance reports exclude ordinary odor/perception
evidence.primary: Dalton/Wysocki1996; O’Mahony1978; Sabiniewicz etal2021; positive Pio testimony
evidence.limit: No actual source identified; strongest unprimed/transported-object reports unresolved.

requirements.inspection: Three Fatima arguments address phenomenology, prediction and regional corroboration; one Zeitoun argument addresses figure recognition; two Pio arguments address chemical exclusion and fragrance attribution. Bounded targets stated; entire cases not falsely called refuted.
Checked source files exist; new DCF scans visually inspected; Arabic report visually checked in prior pass. Clinical/experimental access limits disclosed, including abstract-only readings.

requirements.requirement: Preserve prior findings and strongest counterevidence
requirements.inspection: Closed objections not declared won; favorable controls, full-figure testimony, advance promise and remote testimony retained. No score changed.

requirements.evidence: Readiness explicitly stated in commentary immediately before completion audit; self-contained final notification follows.

judgment: These arguments are ready to defend in their stated bounded forms, not proven true or sufficient to defeat every event. Document structure/file checks establish artifact availability, not the truth of historical or causal conclusions.
